question: On Ordering the Previous Question — Providing for consideration of the bills H.R. 9576 and H.R. 10326, providing for consideration of the joint resolutions H.J. Res. 210 and H.J. Res. 213, and providing for consideration of the Senate amendments to H.R. 5334 (H RES 1530)
plain_language: This procedural vote is on the rule for the fraud-division bill, the fraud-data bill, two California emissions disapprovals, and the Senate changes to the Russia-sanctions bill. A Yea ends debate and forces a vote on the rule. A Nay tries to keep that debate open.
